paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 4.98, with a 0.61% change from the prior close and a -13.54% change over a window of 22 sessions. The price quote is as of September 18, 2026.

Other news includes the arrival of power generation assets at Project Matador, marking a major milestone for the company.
